meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Investor management and fund administration software for private equity and real estate general partners

analysis.summary: Rivals are refreshing product pages and pushing AI connectors (MCP). Agora publishes the most customer proof, while Juniper Square's last 30 days were light: 3 new pages.

points.text: Agora is the closest rival for switchers: 10 new pages, 48 updates, 9 case studies, plus onboarding and investor portal pages.
Three rivals now push MCP (a way for AI tools to connect to a firm's data). Juniper Square's new page covers APIs only.
SS&C GlobalOps mass-produces research and guides (24 new pages), but for middle-office buyers, not GPs comparing investor portals.

Juniper Square.play: Small burst: AI thought piece, one case study, mobile CRM and API product pages.

Allvue Systems.play: Refreshes 13 product pages across credit, PE and compliance; adds fund administration and loan market news.
Allvue Systems.aimed: Large institutional managers, credit and PE

SS&C GlobalOps.play: Publishes a high volume of research, guides and opinion on outsourcing, SMAs and family offices.

InvestNext.play: Updated 17 pages, mostly product pages and investor portal guides, with MCP as the big theme.

Agora.play: Refreshes the whole site, adds case studies and AI guides, and ships launches in a monthly series.
Agora.aimed: Real estate GPs ready to buy

shared.title: MCP and open data access
shared.text: Allvue has MCP Connectors, InvestNext has about five MCP pages, and Agora has API and MCP access. Juniper Square should explain how its APIs work with AI tools.

shared.title: Product page refresh push
shared.text: Allvue updated 13 pages, InvestNext 17 and Agora 48, versus 1 for Juniper Square. Rivals are tuning buying pages, so Juniper Square's older pages may look stale.

shared.title: AI education for GPs
shared.text: Agora, InvestNext and SS&C GlobalOps all publish AI how-tos or opinion pieces. Juniper Square has one AI piece, so it competes for attention here.

gaps.title: Switching guides
gaps.text: No one publishes a migration playbook for changing fund admin or portal providers. Agora's onboarding page is the closest, and it is only one page.

gaps.title: Fund admin plus portal buyer content
gaps.text: Allvue's BPM news and Agora's Verivest case study touch fund administration. Nobody explains what moving both to one provider involves.

gaps.title: Numbers-led switcher stories
gaps.text: Agora leads with 9 case studies and results like 70% more investor engagement. Juniper Square has one, so before-and-after switch stories are open.

versus.Allvue Systems: Allvue ships far more page updates (13 vs 1) but aims at credit and institutional buyers. Juniper Square has more focus on GP investor tools.
versus.SS&C GlobalOps: SS&C publishes 24 new pages against Juniper Square's 3, mostly research for learning. Juniper Square is the one with buyer-facing portal and CRM pages.
versus.InvestNext: InvestNext updated 17 pages around MCP and investor portal guides. Juniper Square has less portal how-to content but has an API page and a mobile app page.
versus.Agora: Agora outpaces Juniper Square on volume (10 new, 48 updated), case studies (9 vs 1) and AI guides, and targets the same switchers.
